item.title: Veronica Guerin Exposed Drug Gangs Despite Death Threats
item.description: Irish journalist Veronica Guerin continued investigating organised crime despite threats and violent attacks. Her murder in June 1996 prompted national outrage and helped drive changes in Ireland’s response to criminal gangs, including the creation of the Criminal Assets Bureau.

item.title: Johnny Gosch Vanished While Starting His Paper Route
item.description: Twelve-year-old Johnny Gosch disappeared in West Des Moines, Iowa, on September 5, 1982, while beginning his morning paper route. His parents pushed for answers and changes to how missing children cases were handled. Decades later, his whereabouts remain unknown.

item.title: Eileen Franklin Testimony Led to a Conviction Later Overturned
item.description: Eileen Franklin said a recovered childhood memory implicated her father in the 1969 murder of her friend Susan Nason. Her testimony helped convict George Franklin in 1990, but trial errors led to the conviction being overturned in 1995. Prosecutors dropped the case in 1996.
